name: Tiny Lamia
source:
A young Lamia that is still immature in both power and ability. One of the four bandits, she too steals from travelers and merchants. In addition, if her target is a weak man, she tries to wrap her small tail around them.

Following her Lamia instincts in wanting to coil around men, her weak tail is barely able to cause pain. However, her tight vagina is more than enough to force a man to submit to her. If she manages a man into her, they are sure to be squeezed dry.

Her only purpose in attacking men is from instinct and the desire to feed. She is unable to rape for reproductive purposes yet.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
